title: jaya jaya shrI raghu rAma - mangaLa kaishiki - Adi - thyAgarAja
name: jaya jaya shrI raghu rAma

sections.title: pallavi
lyrics: jaya jaya shrI raghu rAma - jana hRdhayArNava sOma

cells: , , P P , S S , R , , , R S R ,
, , S R , G R , S , , , R S S D.

sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: sammathamuna nA mEnu nI - sommani vEDukonnAnu

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: gathi hInuDaiyalasi - CHithi nIvE kAvalasi

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: anyula nE kOrithinA - rAjanya ninnu dhUrithinA

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: ninnE nA madhi kOra rAma - nannalayinchuTa mErA

sections.title: charaNam 5
lyrics: nanu maravaku shubha karamA - ninnanusarinca nA tharamA

sections.title: charaNam 6
lyrics: mAkikanEvvaru lEru jUDa - nIkika nyAyamu gAdhu

sections.title: charaNam 7
lyrics: Adharinchanu parAkAy I - khEdhamu lika nEndAka

sections.title: charaNam 8
lyrics: viparIthamulEnchithinO - yE aparAdhamu jEsithinO

sections.title: charaNam 9
lyrics: vAsi lEdhanuchu chalamO nE - jEsina pUjA phalamO

sections.title: charaNam 10
lyrics: nI sari vElpulu lEru rAma - nA sari dInulu lEru

sections.title: charaNam 11
lyrics: tElupanu evvaru lEdhA nA - kalavaramulu vina rAdhA

sections.title: charaNam 12
lyrics: pAdamulaku vandhanamu nA - mIdhanEla dhandanamu

sections.title: charaNam 13
lyrics: tALa jAla yI raTTu rAma - jAlamEla chEyi baTTu

sections.title: charaNam 14
lyrics: nara varulI dharalOna nI - karuNa lEdhanaga valEnA

sections.title: charaNam 15
lyrics: nEramEnchuTaku pOka sari - vAralu navvaga nIka

sections.title: charaNam 16
lyrics: mAnamu nIdE summi - abhimAnamunElukommi

sections.title: charaNam 17
lyrics: pAdamulE gathiyaNTi kali - bAdha tharamu gAdhaNTi

sections.title: charaNam 18
lyrics: chakkani nI rUpamunu gani - sokkiti nA hRdhayamunu

sections.title: charaNam 19
lyrics: kaTa kaTa pAvana nAma - manasITu thirugani shrI rAma

sections.title: charaNam 20
lyrics: Ashinchina nA paini - nIkAshu niNDa dhaya rAni

sections.title: charaNam 21
lyrics: nA bhAgyamu nIdErA padma - nAbha amara parivAra

sections.title: charaNam 22
lyrics: chAlu chAlu raghu vIra - nannElukOrA manasAra

sections.title: charaNam 23
lyrics: rAjitha nava maNi bhUsha thyAga-rAja vinuta mRdhu bhAsha
